🚀 DevToys | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide developers with a single, efficient application containing a wide variety of essential utilities for common development tasks, reducing the need for multiple external tools or websites.
✨ Key Features: • Bundle of tiny tools for specific tasks
📖 Summary: DevToys is a comprehensive suite of developer tools designed to streamline daily tasks. It offers a wide array of utilities for converting, encoding/decoding, formatting, generating, and testing various data types, all within a user-friendly interface. The application also features smart detection to automatically select the appropriate tool for clipboard content and supports extensibility for custom tools.
